summary: The root pull request carries deliverable 3 only (architect, Envoy 2026-10-27 14:39Z): port conflict-baseline.py to Bun/TypeScript as scripts/conflicts/measure.ts (with git.ts, github.ts, analyse.ts, summary.ts, render.ts, types.ts, tsconfig.json, README.md, __tests__, __fixtures__), plus three CI steps in .github/workflows/pr-and-main.yaml's test job after line 288 (biome, tsc -p, bun test for scripts/conflicts). The port keeps the Python measurement and raw JSON layout and adds: date-or-instant window bounds, PR selection by `updated:>=since` (any state, refused at GitHub's 1000-result cap), a combined all-PRs section (the spec's 80/126/253/108/89 figures), `--fixed '<glob>=<commit>'` fix states (before/transition/after by ancestry) and `--compare-with <raw.json>`. No CHANGELOG.md, guide, packages/claude-envoy/dist or packages/claude-envoy/legion edits. Push with tests green early: INFRA-633's tester runs the script from legion/INFRA-588's head. The before raw records are dispatch://INFRA-588/artifact/conflict-baseline-2026-10-20-to-27-json; fetch with `dispatch doc-read --issue INFRA-588 --artifact conflict-baseline-2026-10-20-to-27-json | tail -n +3 > "$TMPDIR/before.json"`.

implement: legion-worker: the PR body (Dispatch line, E2E line, Before section), the proof objects P1-P4 with negative controls at the head that merges, the ce-simplify-code pass, and the production check procedure (pending until merge+7 days, then the comparison run, PR comment and Production line) in references/pr-body.md and references/merge-gate.md
ce-simplify-code: the one simplify pass pr-body.md requires on the new scripts/conflicts code before review
dispatch: reading the before raw records and baseline.md with `dispatch doc-read` for P1-P4 and in the production check
test: legion-worker: re-run P1-P4 from plan.md at the head under test with their negative controls, check the three new CI steps and the required lint/typecheck/test jobs, and record proofs in the test handoff (references/pr-body.md)
dispatch: `dispatch doc-read` of the before raw records and baseline.md, which P1, P2 and P4 compare against
review: legion-worker: references/merge-gate.md (reviewer section) and references/pr-body.md: check the port reproduces baseline.md Part 1 (P1), that tests assert structured counts not wording, that no CHANGELOG.md, guide or claude-envoy built file is touched, and that the README names no private host
